registers.name: qspi_ctrl
registers.description: QSPI control register. Enables the serial engine and selects role, clock mode, bit order and phase format.

fields.name: en
fields.description:
QSPI enable. Allows the shared serial engine to accept a controller or target operation. A value of zero keeps the engine disabled and serial outputs inactive.

Usage: Set after role and transfer configuration are programmed; clear only after the engine is idle.

Values:
0x0 disabled (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: role
fields.description:
QSPI role. Selects controller or Standard SPI target operation for the shared engine. Dual-SPI, Quad-SPI and QPI formats are controller-only.

Usage: Change only while the engine is idle.

Values:
0x0 controller (reset value);
0x1 Standard SPI target.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: cpol
fields.description:
Clock polarity. Selects the idle level of SCLK in Standard SPI modes. Used with cpha to select Standard SPI mode 0 through mode 3.

Usage: Program while idle before starting a transfer.

Values:
0x0 SCLK idle low;
0x1 SCLK idle high.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: cpha
fields.description:
Clock phase. Selects the sampling edge relative to the configured SCLK polarity. Used with cpol to select Standard SPI mode 0 through mode 3.

Usage: Program while idle before starting a transfer.

Values:
0x0 sample on the leading edge;
0x1 sample on the trailing edge.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: lsb_first
fields.description:
Bit order. Selects whether the serial engine transfers the most or least significant bit first. Applies to Standard SPI words; multi-lane ordering follows the selected flash profile.

Usage: Program before starting a Standard SPI transfer.

Values:
0x0 MSB first (reset value);
0x1 LSB first.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: format

registers.name: qspi_clkdiv
registers.description: QSPI clock divider register. Controls controller SCLK frequency from the selected reference clock.

fields.name: divisor
fields.description:
SCLK divisor. Sets the controller clock period as two reference-clock periods times divisor plus one. Program for the selected flash speed before enabling XIP or a controller transfer.

Usage: A larger value produces a lower SCLK frequency.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFF valid divisor encodings;
0xFFFF slowest setting (reset value).

Unit: reference-clock cycles.

Limits: SCLK = f_ref / (2 x (divisor + 1)); maximum rate still requires a selected clock and flash profile..

registers.name: qspi_frame
registers.description: QSPI frame register. Selects the Standard SPI word length.

fields.name: word_len_m1
fields.description:
Word length minus one. Encodes a Standard SPI transfer word from 4 through 32 bits. Write N minus one to request an N-bit word.

Usage: Program while idle before starting a transfer.

Values:
0x3 to 0x1F encode 4 to 32 bits;
0x7 encodes 8 bits (reset value);
0x0 to 0x2 reserved.

Unit: bits.

Limits: Valid encoded values are 3 through 31 inclusive..

registers.name: qspi_xip_cfg
registers.description: QSPI XIP configuration register. Selects a flash read opcode and its command framing for memory-mapped reads.

fields.name: en
fields.description:
XIP enable. Allows AXI4 reads to be translated into flash read transactions. Enable only after firmware configures and verifies the attached NOR flash profile.

Usage: Clear before changing the read profile or entering target role.

Values:
0x0 XIP disabled (reset value);
0x1 XIP enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: opcode
fields.description:
Read opcode. Selects the flash-specific instruction byte for XIP reads. Firmware programs the opcode required by the identified NOR device.

Usage: Set before enabling XIP.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF flash-defined instruction values;
0x03 is a conservative single-lane read example (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: addr_bytes
fields.description:
Address byte count. Selects three-byte or four-byte flash addressing for XIP requests. Firmware selects this based on the flash capacity and address-mode configuration.

Usage: Set before enabling XIP.

Values:
0x0 three address bytes (reset value);
0x1 four address bytes;
0x2 to 0x3 reserved.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: format
dummy_cyc
fields.description:
Dummy-cycle count. Selects idle serial clock cycles between the address/mode phase and returned flash data. Firmware programs the number required by the selected NOR read opcode and clock rate.

Usage: Set before enabling XIP.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF dummy cycles.

Unit: SCLK cycles.

Limits: Exact interpretation for dual/quad data rates depends on the selected flash profile..

registers.name: qspi_xip_mode
registers.description: QSPI XIP mode register. Supplies optional mode bits that some NOR read commands require.

fields.name: mode_value
fields.description:
Mode-bit value. Supplies up to eight optional mode bits after the flash address phase. Use with mode_count for a flash command whose datasheet defines mode bits.

Usage: Set before enabling XIP.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF; reset value is zero.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: mode_count
fields.description:
Mode-bit count. Selects how many low-order mode_value bits are transmitted. Zero disables the mode-bit phase; nonzero values are sent most-significant selected bit first.

Usage: Set before enabling XIP.

Values:
0x0 no mode bits;
0x1 to 0x8 transmit one to eight bits;
0x9 to 0x1F reserved.

Unit: bits.

Limits: Count shall not exceed eight..

registers.name: qspi_cmd
registers.description: QSPI indirect command register. Programs an arbitrary flash command and starts an indirect transaction.

fields.name: opcode
fields.description:
Indirect opcode. Selects the flash instruction used by the software-started operation. Supports device-specific read, program, erase, status and QPI entry/exit instructions.

Usage: Program before setting start.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF flash-defined instruction values.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: format
addr_bytes
dummy_cyc
fields.description:
Indirect dummy-cycle count. Selects idle serial clock cycles before receiving read data. Applies only when the selected command has an input data phase.

Usage: Program before setting start.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF SCLK cycles.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rd
fields.description:
Data direction. Selects whether the indirect operation receives or transmits data after the command/address phases. Read data is written to the RX FIFO; transmit data is consumed from the TX FIFO.

Usage: Program before setting start.

Values:
0x0 transmit data (reset value);
0x1 receive data.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: start
fields.description:
Start request. Starts the programmed indirect transaction and is cleared by hardware when accepted. All command, address, length and FIFO data must be ready before software sets this bit.

Usage: Write one only while idle; hardware clears it when the request is accepted.

Values:
0x0 no request (reset value);
0x1 request operation.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: qspi_addr
registers.description: QSPI indirect address register. Holds the flash address for the next indirect operation.

fields.name: addr
fields.description:
Flash address. Selects the byte address used by an indirect command with an address phase. Only the low-order bytes selected by addr_bytes are transmitted.

Usage: Program before setting qspi_cmd.start.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF flash byte address.

Unit: bytes.

Limits: Address range beyond the selected device capacity is invalid..

registers.name: qspi_len
registers.description: QSPI indirect length register. Selects the number of bytes transferred in the data phase.

fields.name: byte_count
fields.description:
Byte count. Sets the number of payload bytes in an indirect data phase. Program TX FIFO before a transmit operation; drain RX FIFO after a receive operation.

Usage: Set before qspi_cmd.start.

Values:
0x0000 no payload;
0x0001 to 0xFFFF payload bytes.

Unit: bytes.

Limits: Maximum supported count and command-specific constraints depend on FIFO/arbitration design..

registers.name: qspi_sts
registers.description: QSPI status register. Reports the current engine and FIFO state to software.

fields.name: busy
fields.description:
Engine busy. Indicates that the shared serial engine is executing an operation. Software waits for zero before changing role or transfer configuration.

Usage: Asserted during an active serial transaction.

Values:
0x0 idle;
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tx_full
fields.description:
Transmit FIFO full. Indicates that no additional TX data word can be accepted. Software uses this status before writing the TX FIFO data window.

Usage: Reflects the live FIFO full condition.

Values:
0x0 not full;
0x1 full.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tx_empty
fields.description:
Transmit FIFO empty. Indicates that no queued TX data word is available. Software uses this status to refill or verify the transmit FIFO.

Usage: Reflects the live FIFO empty condition.

Values:
0x0 has data;
0x1 empty (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx_full
fields.description:
Receive FIFO full. Indicates that no additional RX data word can be stored. Software drains the RX FIFO to avoid receive overflow.

Usage: Reflects the live FIFO full condition.

Values:
0x0 not full;
0x1 full.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx_empty
fields.description:
Receive FIFO empty. Indicates that no received data word is available. Software reads the RX FIFO only when data is available.

Usage: Reflects the live FIFO empty condition.

Values:
0x0 has data;
0x1 empty (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: err_code

registers.name: qspi_irq_raw
registers.description: QSPI raw interrupt register. Contains sticky hardware event flags.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Command completion event. Indicates that the latest indirect serial operation has finished and software may inspect its result.

Usage: Hardware sets this sticky event flag; software clears it by writing one to this bit.

Values:
0x0 event not pending;
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

fields.name: tx_err
fields.description:
Transmit FIFO error event. Indicates that the serial engine requested transmit data when the FIFO policy reported it unavailable.

Usage: Hardware sets this sticky event flag; software clears it by writing one to this bit.

Values:
0x0 event not pending;
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

fields.name: rx_err
fields.description:
Receive FIFO error event. Indicates that received serial data could not be stored or the RX FIFO data access was invalid.

Usage: Hardware sets this sticky event flag; software clears it by writing one to this bit.

Values:
0x0 event not pending;
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

fields.name: fl_err
fields.description:
Indirect command/configuration error event. Indicates the IP detected an invalid command configuration or unsupported phase profile; it does not indicate external flash busy, program/erase failure, or vendor-specific status.

Usage: Hardware sets this sticky event flag; software clears it by writing one to this bit.

Values:
0x0 event not pending;
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

registers.name: qspi_irq_en
registers.description: QSPI interrupt enable register. Enables selected raw events for the external interrupt output.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Command completion event. Indicates that the latest indirect serial operation has finished and software may inspect its result.

Usage: Set one to allow this pending event to contribute to the level-sensitive QSPI interrupt output.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

fields.name: tx_err
fields.description:
Transmit FIFO error event. Indicates that the serial engine requested transmit data when the FIFO policy reported it unavailable.

Usage: Set one to allow this pending event to contribute to the level-sensitive QSPI interrupt output.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

registers.name: qspi_irq_inj
registers.description: QSPI interrupt injection register. Injects rising-edge test events into the raw event state.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Command completion event. Indicates that the latest indirect serial operation has finished and software may inspect its result.

Usage: Software writes zero and then one to inject a rising-edge test event into the corresponding raw event bit.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 rising-edge injection request.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

registers.name: qspi_irq_sts
registers.description: QSPI interrupt status register. Reports enabled pending interrupt events.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Command completion event. Indicates that the latest indirect serial operation has finished and software may inspect its result.

Usage: Read this bit to see whether the matching event is pending and enabled at the QSPI interrupt output.

Values:
0x0 no enabled pending event;
0x1 enabled event pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: event meaning is as defined by the IP specification.

registers.name: qspi_cs_cfg
registers.description: QSPI chip-select configuration register. Selects a controller flash chip and its inactive timing.

fields.name: cs_sel
fields.description:
Controller chip-select index. Selects one of the parameterized controller CS outputs.

Usage: Program while idle; the value must be less than PARA_NUM_CS.

Values:
0x0 to 0xF controller chip-select index.

Unit: index.

Limits: Legal index range depends on PARA_NUM_CS.

fields.name: cs_setup
fields.description:
Chip-select setup delay. Sets reference-clock cycles from CS assertion to the first SCLK edge.

Usage: Program for the selected flash timing before a controller operation.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF delay cycles.

Unit: reference-clock cycles.

Limits: Timing requirements depend on the selected flash datasheet.

fields.name: cs_hold
fields.description:
Chip-select hold delay. Sets reference-clock cycles from the final SCLK edge to CS deassertion.

Usage: Program for the selected flash timing before a controller operation.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF delay cycles.

Unit: reference-clock cycles.

Limits: Timing requirements depend on the selected flash datasheet.

fields.name: cs_high
fields.description:
Chip-select inactive delay. Sets the minimum reference-clock cycles between controller transactions.

Usage: Program for the selected flash timing before a controller operation.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF delay cycles.

Unit: reference-clock cycles.

Limits: Timing requirements depend on the selected flash datasheet.
